name: multitelas
description: MultiTelas — mídia indoor para TVs corporativas (digital signage)

scripts.build: npm --prefix web install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.lint:nomes: npx --yes eslint@8 --no-eslintrc --env node,es2022 --parser-options=ecmaVersion:2022 --rule no-undef:error server.js 'server/*.js' 'server/routes/*.js' && npm run lint:nomes-painel
scripts.lint:nomes-painel: npx --yes -p eslint@8 -p eslint-plugin-react@7 sh -c 'eslint --no-eslintrc --no-inline-config --resolve-plugins-relative-to "$(dirname $(dirname $(command -v eslint)))" --plugin react --env browser,es2022 --parser-options=ecmaVersion:2022,sourceType:module,ecmaFeatures:{jsx:true} --global globalThis --rule react/jsx-no-undef:error --rule no-undef:error --rule react/jsx-uses-vars:error "web/src/**/*.{js,jsx}"'
